<!-- pr-reviewer: 8384ed9c4c838089e970660f6f1af2e564ef2d9b -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Diff is exactly what the PR says: +1/-49 in `crates/app/src/tool_body_view.rs` and `crates/app/tests/tool_body_view.rs`. Removed `bare_assembly`, `assembly_for_operation`, the `ToolKind` import that only `bare_assembly` used, and one test. Nothing else in `tool_body_view.rs` changed: `assembly`, `revolve`, `body_for_operation`, `preview`, `pick`, `posed` are untouched.
- No remaining reference to either removed name anywhere in tracked files on the trial merge with current main (`git grep` over the whole tree, including `crates/ui`, MCP, tests, docs and `.claude/skills/`).
- The removed test asserted only `bare_assembly` (its tip-to-holder-top extent, holder-cylinder radius, and the lathe-insert `None`). Its underlying geometry (`Tool::profile` with its holder cylinder) stays covered by `crates/tools/src/tools.rs` (profile tests around L606-651), `crates/tools/src/spun_tests.rs` and `crates/app/tests/tool_spun_profile.rs:159`. Deleting it was right.

**Local results (trial merge with origin/main, head 8384ed9c)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo check -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets` | Finished, 0 warnings |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test tool_body_view` | 7 passed, 0 failed (8 -> 7 as stated) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Finished, clean |

**Reference search**
- Trial merge, whole tree (tracked files): no `assembly_for_operation` or `bare_assembly` left.
- Open PR #843 (reach laws): its diff removes a call to `camcraft_app::tool_body_view::assembly_for_operation` (in `crates/ui`, the sim tool draw path, replaced by a `sim_tool_pose` helper). Current main has no caller left, so #843 is not blocked by this PR. Merge order note for the maintainer: either order works, since #859 only deletes unused functions and #843 deletes the one call; if #843 merges first, #859 is still clean.
- Open PR #856 (cutter profile editor): no use of either removed name.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- `cargo test` was run for the one binary the diff touches; the wider UI suites were not run because nothing in `crates/ui` references the removed names.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
